2609.18496.title: MiST: Mid-Training LLMs for Cybersecurity
2609.18496.paper_summary: Cybersecurity combines high-stakes analysis with complex technical language, making it an impactful and challenging domain for LLMs. We present MiST (Mid-trained Security Transformer), a suite of 8B and 32B models that achieve strong performance on public cybersecurity benchmarks. We use mid-training as an intermediate adaptation stage between general pre-training and cybersecurity training. Rather than performing continual pre-training over large volumes of raw domain text, we curate a compact, expert-vetted seed corpus, and transform it into high-quality domain-specific synthetic training data. The final MiST checkpoints improve mean cybersecurity accuracy by +13.1 and +8.6 absolute percentage points over the corresponding Qwen baselines for 8B and 32B, respectively, corresponding to relative gains of +27.0% and +15.8%. Ablation results further show that these cybersecurity gains arise in the mid-training and supervised fine-tuning stages through a combination of the synthetic data generation flows. Furthermore, we show that MiST provides a stronger initialization for downstream task-specific fine-tuning adaptation and reinforcement learning.
2609.18496.paper_summary_zh: 網絡安全結合了高風險的分析和複雜的技術語言，使其成為對大型語言模型（LLMs）具有影響力且具有挑戰性的領域。<lb/>我們提出了MiST（中階訓練安全Transformer），這是一套8B和32B模型，在公共網絡安全基準測試中表現出色。<lb/>我們使用中階訓練作為一般預訓練和網絡安全訓練之間的中介適應階段。<lb/>與其對大量原始領域文本進行持續預訓練，我們策劃了一個緊湊的、專家審核的種子語料庫，並將其轉換為高質量的領域特定合成訓練數據。<lb/>最終的MiST檢查點在8B和32B上分別提高了平均網絡安全準確率13.1和8.6個絕對百分點，對應於相對增益的27.0%和15.8%。<lb/>消融結果進一步顯示，這些網絡安全增益是在中階訓練和監督微調階段通過合成數據生成流程的組合產生的。<lb/>此外，我們顯示MiST為下游任務特定的微調適應和強化學習提供了更強的初始化。
